var_label: Housing Quality: Lacking Complete Kitchen Facilities
var_def: Percentage of homes that lack a complete kitchen. A housing unit is considered to be lacking complete kitchen facilities when it is missing one or more of the following: a sink with a faucet, a stove or range, and a refrigerator.
ylabs: Housing Quality: Lacking Complete Kitchen Facilities  (%)

var_label: Housing Quality: Lacking Complete Plumbing Facilities
var_def: Percentage of homes that lack complete plumbing. A housing unit is considered to be lacking complete plumbing facilities when it is missing one or more of the following: hot and cold running water and a bathtub or shower.
ylabs: Housing Quality: Lacking Complete Plumbing Facilities  (%)
